title: EU ministers seek balance between workplace rights and competitiveness in 21st century jobs act
lede: The Quality Jobs Act covers common standards for being able to ‘go home’ and disconnect from remote work, and limits AI's role in recruitment or scrutiny of workers’ performance.

title: Why Spain’s Left missed the chance to unite ahead of November’s snap election
lede: Spain’s Left has missed its last chance to unite ahead of the snap election on 29 November — a historic failure, not so much because the numbers don’t add up, but because it now fails to offer an alternative.
